'''Jeremy Thompson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Atlanta DPC]] on 28 July 2001 with EBO Baragwin's, according to Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2766">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-03-then-again-maybe-i-do-dpc-atlantad2766/ then-again-maybe-i-do-dpc-atlanta], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 3 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-03-then-again-maybe-i-do-dpc-atlantad2766/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
